```{r data-preparation}
library(rjson)
library(dplyr)

maxevals <- params$maxevals

archivos_existentes <- list.files("data/statistics/", pattern = "-stats-.*_exp_.*_run_.*\\.json$")

if (length(archivos_existentes) == 0) {
  stop("Error: No se ha encontrado ningún archivo JSON en 'data/statistics/'. Revisa la ruta.")
}

patron_regex <- "^([^-]+)-stats-(.*?)_exp_(\\d+)_run_\\d+\\.json$"
matches <- regmatches(archivos_existentes, regexec(patron_regex, archivos_existentes))

meta_files <- data.frame(
  archivo  = archivos_existentes,
  alg_base = sapply(matches, function(x) x[2]),
  instance = sapply(matches, function(x) x[3]),
  exp_num  = sapply(matches, function(x) x[4]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Mapeo limpio para leyendas y cabeceras
meta_files$alg_comb <- case_when(
  meta_files$exp_num == "1" ~ "C1 (Sin Señales)",
  meta_files$exp_num == "3" ~ "C3 (Con Señales)",
  TRUE ~ paste0("C", meta_files$exp_num)
)

algorithms <- sort(unique(meta_files$alg_comb))
instances  <- sort(unique(meta_files$instance))

# Funciones de muestreo y agregacion
sampling <- function (rundata, s, maxevals) {
  if (is.null(rundata) || is.null(rundata$evals) || length(rundata$evals) == 0) {
    numsamples <- floor(maxevals/s)
    return(matrix(NA, nrow=numsamples, ncol=2))
  }
  n = length(rundata$evals)
  numsamples <- floor(maxevals/s)
  mat <- matrix(nrow=numsamples, ncol=2)
  first <- rundata$evals[1]
  
  if (length(first) == 0 || is.na(first)) return(matrix(NA, nrow=numsamples, ncol=2))

  i <- 1
  for (j in seq(from = 1, to = numsamples)) {
    ev <- j * s;
    mat[j,1] <- ev
    if (ev < first) {
      mat[j,2] <- NA
    } else {
      while ((i<=n) & (rundata$evals[i] < ev)) {
        i <- i + 1
      }
      if ((i<=n) & (rundata$evals[i] == ev)) {
        k <- i
      } else {
        k <- i - 1
      }
      if (k > 0 && k <= length(rundata$data)) {
        mat[j,2] <- rundata$data[k]
      } else {
        mat[j,2] <- NA
      }
    }
  }
  return (mat)
} 

stderror <- function(x) {
  x <- na.omit(x)
  if(length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))
}

statmat <- function(lst, fnc) {        
  if (length(lst) == 0) return(NULL)
  rc <- dim(lst[[1]]) 
  if (is.null(rc)) return(NULL)
  ar1 <- array(unlist(lst), c(rc, length(lst))) 
  mat <- apply(ar1, c(1, 2), fnc)
  colnames(mat)=c("evals", "best", "current", "mean", "diversity")
  return(mat)
}

process_rundata <- function (rundata) {
  s <- 100
  if (is.null(rundata$isols) || is.null(rundata$idata)) {
    dummy_evals <- seq(s, maxevals, by=s)
    mat_dummy <- matrix(NA, nrow=length(dummy_evals), ncol=5)
    colnames(mat_dummy) <- c("evals", "best", "current", "mean", "diversity")
    return(mat_dummy)
  }
  df <- data.frame("evals" = rundata$isols$evals, "data" = rundata$isols$fitness)
  mat1 <- sampling(df, s, maxevals)
  
  df <- data.frame("evals" = rundata$idata$evals, "data" = rundata$idata$best)
  mat2 <- sampling(df, s, maxevals)
  mat1 <- cbind(mat1, mat2[,2])
  
  df <- data.frame("evals" = rundata$idata$evals, "data" = rundata$idata$mean)
  mat2 <- sampling(df, s, maxevals)
  mat1 <- cbind(mat1, mat2[,2])
  
  df <- data.frame("evals" = rundata$idata$evals, "data" = rundata$idata$diversity)
  mat2 <- sampling(df, s, maxevals)
  mat1 <- cbind(mat1, mat2[,2])
  
  colnames(mat1) <- c("evals", "best", "current", "mean", "diversity")  
  return (mat1)
}

process_runbatch <- function (data) {
  if (is.null(data) || length(data) == 0) return(NULL)
  stats <- list()
  numislands <- length(data[[1]]$rundata)
  numruns <- length(data)
  resbestall <- NULL
  
  for (i in seq(1, numruns)) {
    runmat <- process_rundata(data[[i]]$rundata[[1]])
    if (i == 1) resbestall <- data.frame("evals" = runmat[,"evals"])
    if (numislands > 1) {
      for (j in seq(2, numislands)) {
        mat <- process_rundata(data[[i]]$rundata[[j]])
        runmat[,"current"] <- pmax(runmat[,"current"], mat[,"current"], na.rm=TRUE)
        runmat[,"best"] <- pmax(runmat[,"best"], mat[,"best"], na.rm=TRUE)
        runmat[,"mean"] <- runmat[,"mean"] + mat[,"mean"]
        runmat[,"diversity"] <- runmat[,"diversity"] + mat[,"diversity"]
      }
      runmat[,"mean"] <- runmat[,"mean"]/numislands
      runmat[,"diversity"] <- runmat[,"diversity"]/numislands
    }
    stats[[i]] <- runmat
    if (!is.null(resbestall)) resbestall[paste0("run", i)] <- runmat[,"best"]
  }
  resmean <- as.data.frame(statmat(stats, function(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)))
  resse <- as.data.frame(statmat(stats, stderror))
  return (list("mean"=resmean, "se"=resse, "all" = resbestall))
}

get_solutions <- function (data) {
  if (is.null(data) || length(data) == 0) return(NULL)
  numruns <- length(data)
  
  genome_sample <- NULL
  if(!is.null(data[[1]]$rundata[[1]]$isols$genome)) {
      genome_sample <- data[[1]]$rundata[[1]]$isols$genome
  }
  
  numvar <- if (is.null(genome_sample)) 0 else length(genome_sample[[1]])
  
  table_solutions <- data.frame(matrix(ncol=numvar+2, nrow=numruns))
  colnames(table_solutions) <- c("evals", "fitness", paste("V", seq_len(numvar), sep=""))
  
  for (i in 1:numruns) {
    isols <- data[[i]]$rundata[[1]]$isols
    if (!is.null(isols) && length(isols$evals) > 0) {
      rowi <- max(which(isols$evals < maxevals))
      if (is.infinite(rowi)) rowi <- length(isols$evals)
      table_solutions[i, "evals"] <- isols$evals[rowi]
      table_solutions[i, "fitness"] <- isols$fitness[rowi]
      if (numvar > 0) {
        for (j in seq_len(numvar)) {
          table_solutions[i, j+2] <- isols$genome[rowi][[1]][j]
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return(table_solutions)
}

data_list <- vector("list", length(instances) * length(algorithms))
idx <- 1

for (instance in instances) {
  for (alg in algorithms) {
    batch_data <- list()
    run_count <- 1
    
    sub_meta <- meta_files[meta_files$instance == instance & meta_files$alg_comb == alg, ]
    
    if (nrow(sub_meta) > 0) {
      alg_base_actual <- sub_meta$alg_base[1]
      exp_num_actual  <- sub_meta$exp_num[1]
      
      for (r in 0:29) { # 30 runs
        json_filename <- paste0("data/statistics/", alg_base_actual, "-stats-", instance, "_exp_", exp_num_actual, "_run_", r, ".json")
        
        if (file.exists(json_filename)) {
          json_run <- tryCatch(fromJSON(file = json_filename), error = function(e) NULL)
          if (!is.null(json_run) && length(json_run) > 0) {
            batch_data[[run_count]] <- json_run[[1]]
            run_count <- run_count + 1
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (length(batch_data) > 0) {
      processed <- process_runbatch(batch_data)
      sols <- get_solutions(batch_data)
      data_list[[idx]] <- list("rundata" = processed, "sols" = sols)
    } else {
      data_list[[idx]] <- NA 
    }
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}

data_processed <- matrix(data = data_list, ncol = length(instances),
                         dimnames = list(algorithms, instances))
instances_escaped <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", instances)
```

# Resultados


```{r fitness-evol, fig.cap = "Evolución de fitness promediada (30 ejecuciones, 5 simulaciones por evaluación) para C1 (Visión Global) y C3 (Visión Local).", out.width="100%", fig.height=5.5, fig.align="center"}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)

df_evol_all <- data.frame()

for (instance in instances) {
  mapa_val <- case_when(
    grepl("office", instance, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Oficina",
    grepl("supermarket", instance, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Supermercado",
    grepl("diaphanous", instance, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Diáfano",
    TRUE ~ "General"
  )
  rq_val <- case_when(
    grepl("rq1", instance, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ1 (Señales)",
    grepl("rq2", instance, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ2 (Atacante)",
    grepl("rq3", instance, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ3 (Policías)",
    TRUE ~ "General"
  )
  
  for (alg in algorithms) {
    if (is.list(data_processed[[alg, instance]])) {
      rd <- data_processed[[alg, instance]][["rundata"]]
      if (!is.null(rd$mean)) {
        
        # Etiqueta precisa de visión
        alg_label <- ifelse(grepl("exp3", alg) || grepl("C3", alg), "C3 (Visión Local)", "C1 (Visión Global)")
        
        temp <- data.frame(
          evals = rd[["mean"]]$evals,
          best  = rd[["mean"]]$best,
          se    = rd[["se"]]$best,
          alg   = alg_label,
          Mapa  = mapa_val,
          RQ    = rq_val,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        temp$best[temp$best < 1e-4] <- 1e-4
        df_evol_all <- rbind(df_evol_all, temp)
      }
    }
  }
}

if (nrow(df_evol_all) > 0) {
  ggplot(df_evol_all, aes(x = evals, y = best, color = alg, group = alg)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(best - se, 1e-4), ymax = best + se, fill = alg), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", labels = scales::label_scientific(digits = 2)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("C1 (Visión Global)" = "#e74c3c", "C3 (Visión Local)" = "#1abc9c")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("C1 (Visión Global)" = "#e74c3c", "C3 (Visión Local)" = "#1abc9c")) +
    facet_grid(RQ ~ Mapa, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = "Evaluaciones",
      y = "Fitness Promedio (Escala Log10)",
      color = "Configuración",
      fill = "Configuración"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

```{r test-data-preparation, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Cargamos todos los archivos de resultado y simulación
results_files <- list.files("data/results/", pattern = "^result_.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
test_files    <- list.files("data/simulations/", pattern = "^test-stats-.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)

# Función auxiliar para extraer metadatos del nombre de archivo
parse_metadata <- function(filename) {
  map_type <- "Desconocido"
  if (grepl("office", filename, ignore.case = TRUE)) map_type <- "Oficina"
  if (grepl("supermarket", filename, ignore.case = TRUE)) map_type <- "Supermercado"
  if (grepl("diaphanous", filename, ignore.case = TRUE)) map_type <- "Diáfano"
  
  rq_label <- "RQ1 (Señales)"
  if (grepl("rq2", filename, ignore.case = TRUE)) rq_label <- "RQ2 (Atacante)"
  if (grepl("rq3", filename, ignore.case = TRUE)) rq_label <- "RQ3 (Policías)"
  
  return(list(map = map_type, rq = rq_label))
}

```{r test-table-definitiva, echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

test_files    <- list.files("data/simulations/", pattern = "^test-stats-.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
results_files <- list.files("data/results/", pattern = "^result_.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)

parse_entry <- function(filepath) {
  j <- tryCatch(fromJSON(filepath), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(j)) return(NULL)
  
  fname  <- basename(filepath)
  exp_id <- if (!is.null(j$idExperiment)) j$idExperiment else if (!is.null(j$experiment)) j$experiment else 1
  run_id <- if (!is.null(j$idRun)) j$idRun else if (!is.null(j$run)) j$run else 0
  
  mapa_val <- case_when(
    grepl("office", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Oficina",
    grepl("supermarket", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Supermercado",
    grepl("diaphanous", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Diáfano",
    TRUE ~ "General"
  )
  
  rq_val <- case_when(
    grepl("rq1", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ1 (Señales)",
    grepl("rq2", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ2 (Atacante)",
    grepl("rq3", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ3 (Policías)",
    TRUE ~ "General"
  )
  
  is_c2 <- grepl("_c2", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) || exp_id == 2 || exp_id == 101
  is_c3 <- (exp_id == 3 || (exp_id == 2 && !is_c2)) && !grepl("_c2", fname, ignore.case = TRUE)
  
  mode_tag <- case_when(
    is_c2 ~ "C2 (Visión Local - Sin Señales)",
    is_c3 ~ "C3 (Visión Local - Con Señales)",
    TRUE  ~ "C1 (Visión Global)"
  )
  
  exp_train_id <- if (is_c2) 1 else if (is_c3) 3 else exp_id
  clean_instance <- gsub(".*(test-stats|result_)-(.*)_exp_.*", "\\2", fname)
  clean_instance <- gsub("_c2$", "", clean_instance)
  pattern_train   <- paste0(".*", clean_instance, ".*_exp_", exp_train_id, "_run_", run_id, "\\.json$")
  f_train         <- list.files("data/statistics/", pattern = pattern_train, full.names = TRUE)[1]
  
  train_fitness <- NA
  if (!is.na(f_train) && file.exists(f_train)) {
    json_train <- tryCatch(fromJSON(f_train, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(json_train) && length(json_train) > 0) {
      try({
        isols <- json_train[[1]]$rundata[[1]]$isols
        if (!is.null(isols$fitness)) {
          train_fitness <- tail(isols$fitness, 1)[[1]]
        }
      }, silent = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  if (is.na(train_fitness) || length(train_fitness) == 0) {
    train_fitness <- if (!is.null(j$avgFitness)) j$avgFitness else j$fitness
  }
  
  if (!is.null(j$testSimulations) && length(j$testSimulations) > 0) {
    t_mean   <- mean(j$testSimulations, na.rm = TRUE)
    t_median <- median(j$testSimulations, na.rm = TRUE)
    t_iqr    <- IQR(j$testSimulations, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    t_mean   <- if (!is.null(j$fitness)) j$fitness else NA
    t_median <- if (!is.null(j$fitness)) j$fitness else NA
    t_iqr    <- 0
  }
  
  if (is.na(t_mean)) return(NULL)
  
  data.frame(
    Mapa          = mapa_val,
    RQ            = rq_val,
    Instancia     = rq_val,
    Configuracion = mode_tag,
    Exp           = mode_tag,
    Run           = as.numeric(run_id),
    Train_Fitness = as.numeric(train_fitness),
    Test_Mean     = as.numeric(t_mean),
    Test_Median   = as.numeric(t_median),
    Test_IQR      = as.numeric(t_iqr),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

list_sims <- lapply(test_files, parse_entry) %>% compact()
df_sims   <- if (length(list_sims) > 0) do.call(rbind, list_sims) else data.frame()

list_res <- lapply(results_files, parse_entry) %>% compact()
df_res   <- if (length(list_res) > 0) do.call(rbind, list_res) else data.frame()

if (nrow(df_sims) > 0 && nrow(df_res) > 0) {
  df_res_missing <- anti_join(df_res, df_sims, by = c("Mapa", "RQ", "Configuracion", "Run"))
  tabla_datos <- rbind(df_sims, df_res_missing)
} else if (nrow(df_sims) > 0) {
  tabla_datos <- df_sims
} else {
  tabla_datos <- df_res
}

if (!is.null(tabla_datos) && nrow(tabla_datos) > 0) {
  tabla_resumen <- tabla_datos %>%
    group_by(Mapa, RQ, Configuracion) %>%
    summarise(
      `Train (Media)` = sprintf("%.2e", mean(Train_Fitness, na.rm = TRUE)),
      `Test (Media)`  = sprintf("%.4f", mean(Test_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)),
      `Test (Mediana)`= sprintf("%.4f", mean(Test_Median, na.rm = TRUE)),
      `Test (IQR)`    = sprintf("%.4f", mean(Test_IQR, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Mapa, RQ, Configuracion)
  
  kbl(
    tabla_resumen,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    centering = TRUE,
    caption = "Resumen de Fitness: Entrenamiento frente a Test de Estrés desglosado por Mapa y Visión.",
    col.names = c("Mapa", "RQ", "Configuración", "Train (Media)", "Test (Media)", "Test (Mediana)", "Test (IQR)")
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 8) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, latex_hline = "major")
}

```{r fitness}
num_instances <- length(instances)
num_algorithms <- length(algorithms)

# FUNCIÓN DE FORMATEO INTELIGENTE:
# Muestra notación científica (e.g. 6.40e-04) para valores muy pequeños (< 0.01) y decimales normales para el resto.
fmt <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || is.null(x)) return("-")
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (x == 0) return("0")
  if (abs(x) < 0.01) {
    return(sprintf("%.2e", x)) # Formato e-04
  } else {
    return(sprintf("%.3f", x)) # Formato decimal estándar
  }
}

# Función de Wilcoxon protegida contra datos ausentes o insuficientes
getPval <- function(instance, alg1, alg2) {
  if (!is.list(data_processed[[alg1, instance]]) || !is.list(data_processed[[alg2, instance]])) {
    return(1)
  }
  v1 <- data_processed[[alg1, instance]][["sols"]]$fitness
  v2 <- data_processed[[alg2, instance]][["sols"]]$fitness
  
  if (is.null(v1) || is.null(v2) || length(v1) < 2 || length(v2) < 2) {
    return(1)
  }
  
  # Paracaídas si las varianzas son cero para evitar avisos y errores en el test
  if (var(v1, na.rm=TRUE) == 0 && var(v2, na.rm=TRUE) == 0) {
    return(1)
  }
  
  s <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(v1, v2, alternative = "two.sided"), error = function(e) list(p.value=1))
  if (is.na(s$p.value)) {
    s$p.value <- 1
  }
  return(s$p.value)
}

# Función de símbolos protegida
getSymbol <- function (alg, instance) {
  if (is.na(bestalg[instance]) || is.null(bestalg[instance])) {
    return ("$\\phantom{\\bullet}$")
  }
  if (alg == bestalg[instance]) {
    return ("$\\star$")
  }
  pval <- table_significance[instance, alg]
  if (is.na(pval) || pval > 0.05) {
    return ("$\\phantom{\\bullet}$")
  } else {
    return ("$\\bullet$")
  }
}

table_significance <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=num_instances, ncol=num_algorithms))
colnames(table_significance) <- algorithms
rownames(table_significance) <- instances

bestalg <- rep(NA_character_, num_instances)
names(bestalg) <- instances

# Buscamos el mejor algoritmo protegiendo las celdas sin datos reales
for (instance in instances) {
  best <- Inf
  for (alg in algorithms) {
    if (is.list(data_processed[[alg, instance]])) {
      sols <- data_processed[[alg, instance]][["sols"]]
      if (!is.null(sols) && !is.null(sols$fitness) && length(sols$fitness) > 0) {
        val <- mean(sols$fitness, na.rm=TRUE)
        if (!is.na(val) && val < best) {
          best <- val
          bestalg[instance] <- alg
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  for (alg in algorithms) {
    if (!is.na(bestalg[instance])) {
      table_significance[instance, alg] <- getPval(instance, alg, bestalg[instance])
    } else {
      table_significance[instance, alg] <- 1
    }
  }
}

library(kableExtra)

table_fitness <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=num_instances, ncol=4*num_algorithms))
colnames(table_fitness) <- apply(expand.grid(c("best", "median", "mean", "stat"), algorithms), 
                                 1, paste, collapse = ".")
rownames(table_fitness) <- instances

# CABECERA 1 DE GRUPOS (Instancia + 4 columnas por cada algoritmo)
first_header <- c(1, rep(4, num_algorithms))
names(first_header) <- c(" ", algorithms)

# CABECERA 2 DE COLUMNAS (Solo las 4 métricas repetidas por cada algoritmo)
sub_cols <- c("$x^*$", "$\\tilde{x}$", "$\\bar{x} \\pm \\sigma_{\\bar{x}}$", " ")
second_header <- rep(sub_cols, num_algorithms)

# Rellenamos la tabla final usando el nuevo formateador `fmt()`
for (alg in algorithms) {
  for (instance in instances) {
    if (is.list(data_processed[[alg, instance]])) {
      data_solutions <- data_processed[[alg, instance]][["sols"]]
      if (!is.null(data_solutions) && !is.null(data_solutions$fitness) && length(data_solutions$fitness) > 0) {
        
        fits <- data_solutions$fitness
        
        table_fitness[instance, paste("best", alg, sep=".")]   <- fmt(min(fits, na.rm=TRUE))
        table_fitness[instance, paste("median", alg, sep=".")] <- fmt(median(fits, na.rm=TRUE))
        table_fitness[instance, paste("mean", alg, sep=".")]   <- paste(fmt(mean(fits, na.rm=TRUE)), "$\\pm$", fmt(stderror(fits)))
        table_fitness[instance, paste("stat", alg, sep=".")]   <- getSymbol(alg, instance)
        next
      }
    }
    table_fitness[instance, paste("best", alg, sep=".")]   <- "-"
    table_fitness[instance, paste("median", alg, sep=".")] <- "-"
    table_fitness[instance, paste("mean", alg, sep=".")]   <- "N/A"
    table_fitness[instance, paste("stat", alg, sep=".")]   <- " "
  }
}

# Escapamos los guiones bajos (_) en los nombres de las filas y cabeceras
rownames(table_fitness) <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", rownames(table_fitness))
names(first_header)     <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", names(first_header))

# Renderizado seguro de la tabla en LaTeX
table_fitness %>%
  kbl(escape = FALSE,
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      caption = "Resultados globales de las simulaciones. Cada columna muestra el mejor valor encontrado ($x^*$), la mediana ($\\tilde{x}$), la media ($\\bar{x}$) y el error estándar de la media ($\\sigma_{\\bar{x}}$). Una estrella $\\star$ marca al mejor algoritmo en cada instancia, y un símbolo $\\bullet$ indica significación estadística.",
      col.names = second_header) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position")) %>%
  add_header_above(first_header)
```

```{r load-multitrace-data, include=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

trace_files <- list.files("data/traces", pattern = "^trace_.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)

# Pre-cargamos la lista de coordenadas de una sola vez para no escanear el disco en bucle
coord_files <- list.files("data/traces", pattern = "^coordinates_.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)

load_single_trace_fast <- function(f_trace) {
  base_id <- gsub("^trace_", "", gsub("\\.json$", "", basename(f_trace)))
  
  rq_label <- "RQ1 (Señales)"
  if (grepl("rq2", base_id, ignore.case = TRUE)) rq_label <- "RQ2 (Atacante)"
  if (grepl("rq3", base_id, ignore.case = TRUE)) rq_label <- "RQ3 (Policías)"
  
  # 1. Parseo automático simplificado (jsonlite convierte arreglos directamente a data.frame)
  trace_json <- tryCatch(fromJSON(f_trace, simplifyVector = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(trace_json) || is.null(trace_json$snapshots)) return(NULL)
  
  snaps <- trace_json$snapshots
  if (length(snaps) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # 2. Extracción vectorizada limpia (sin hacer data.frame por peatón)
  positions_list <- vector("list", nrow(snaps))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(snaps))) {
    t_val <- snaps$timestamp[i]
    crowd_df <- snaps$crowd[[i]]
    
    if (!is.null(crowd_df) && nrow(crowd_df) > 0) {
      positions_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
        time    = t_val,
        id      = paste0(base_id, "_p", crowd_df$id),
        ped_id  = crowd_df$id,
        x       = crowd_df$location$coordinates$X,
        y       = crowd_df$location$coordinates$Y,
        sim_id  = base_id,
        rq      = rq_label,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  positions <- bind_rows(positions_list)
  
  # 3. Carga rápida de salidas/coordenadas
  coords_df <- NULL
  f_coords <- coord_files[grepl(paste0("coordinates_", base_id, "\\.json$"), coord_files)]
  if (length(f_coords) > 0 && file.exists(f_coords[1])) {
    coords_json <- tryCatch(fromJSON(f_coords[1], simplifyVector = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(coords_json$exits)) {
      coords_df <- as.data.frame(coords_json$exits) %>%
        mutate(sim_id = base_id, rq = rq_label)
    }
  }
  
  return(list(positions = positions, exits = coords_df))
}

# Ejecución paralela o mapeada rápida
all_data <- lapply(trace_files, load_single_trace_fast) %>% compact()

all_positions <- lapply(all_data, `[[`, "positions") %>% bind_rows()
all_exits     <- lapply(all_data, `[[`, "exits") %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r heatmap-density, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Mapa de calor de densidad espacial separado por entorno y pregunta de investigación.", out.width="100%", fig.height=6, fig.align="center"}
if (exists("all_positions") && nrow(all_positions) > 0) {
  
  # Asignar metadatos de mapa a cada posición
  all_positions <- all_positions %>%
    mutate(mapa = case_when(
      grepl("office", sim_id, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Oficina",
      grepl("supermarket", sim_id, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Supermercado",
      grepl("diaphanous", sim_id, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Diáfano",

  ggplot(all_positions, aes(x = x, y = y)) +

    facet_grid(rq ~ mapa, scales = "free") +

    )
}

```{r trajectories-sample, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Trayectorias individuales de movimiento de los agentes durante la evacuación.", out.width="100%", fig.height=6, fig.align="center"}
if (exists("all_positions") && nrow(all_positions) > 0) {
  
  sample_positions <- all_positions %>%
    group_by(rq, mapa) %>%
    filter(sim_id == first(sim_id)) %>%
    ungroup()

  starts <- sample_positions %>% group_by(id) %>% filter(time == min(time))
  ends   <- sample_positions %>% group_by(id) %>% filter(time == max(time))

  ggplot(sample_positions, aes(x = x, y = y, color = factor(ped_id), group = id)) +
    geom_path(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = starts, aes(x = x, y = y), shape = 16, size = 1.8) +
    geom_point(data = ends, aes(x = x, y = y), shape = 17, size = 2.5) +
    facet_grid(rq ~ mapa, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Coordenada X (m)", y = "Coordenada Y (m)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 1
    )
}

```{r clearance-rate, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Tasa de evacuación acumulada promedio a lo largo del tiempo.", out.width="90%", fig.height=4, fig.align="center"}
if (exists("all_positions") && nrow(all_positions) > 0) {
  
  evac_aggregated <- all_positions %>%
    group_by(rq, sim_id, time) %>%
    summarise(people_remaining = n_distinct(id), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
    mutate(
      total_people = max(people_remaining),
      evacuated = total_people - people_remaining
    ) %>%
    group_by(rq, time) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_evacuated = mean(evacuated),
      sd_evac = sd(evacuated),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ggplot(evac_aggregated, aes(x = time, y = mean_evacuated, color = rq, fill = rq)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_evacuated - sd_evac), ymax = mean_evacuated + sd_evac), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = "Tiempo de Simulación (s)",
      y = "Civiles Evacuados (Promedio)",
      color = "Escenario",
      fill = "Escenario"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

```{r operational-metrics-table, echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

results_files <- list.files("data/results", pattern = "^result_.*\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(results_files) > 0) {
  
  res_list <- lapply(results_files, function(f) {
    j <- tryCatch(fromJSON(f), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(j)) return(NULL)
    
    fname   <- basename(f)
    exp_num <- ifelse(!is.null(j$experiment), as.numeric(j$experiment), 1)
    
    mapa_val <- case_when(
      grepl("office", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Oficina",
      grepl("supermarket", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Supermercado",
      grepl("diaphanous", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Diáfano",
      TRUE ~ "General"
    )
    rq_val <- case_when(
      grepl("rq1", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ1 (Señales)",
      grepl("rq2", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ2 (Atacante)",
      grepl("rq3", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RQ3 (Policías)",
      TRUE ~ "General"
    )
    
    is_c2 <- grepl("_c2", fname, ignore.case = TRUE) || exp_num == 2 || exp_num == 101
    is_c3 <- (exp_num == 3 || (exp_num == 2 && !is_c2)) && !grepl("_c2", fname, ignore.case = TRUE)
    
    config_label <- case_when(
      is_c2 ~ "C2 (Visión Local - Sin Señales)",
      is_c3 ~ "C3 (Visión Local - Con Señales)",
      TRUE  ~ "C1 (Visión Global)"
    )
    
    data.frame(
      Mapa = mapa_val,
      RQ = rq_val,
      Configuracion = config_label,
      Evacuados = ifelse(!is.null(j$civilian_evacuated), j$civilian_evacuated, NA),
      Fallecidos = ifelse(!is.null(j$civilian_killed), j$civilian_killed, 0),
      Atrapados = ifelse(!is.null(j$civilian_trapped), j$civilian_trapped, 0),
      Tiempo_Medio = ifelse(!is.null(j$mean_time), j$mean_time, NA),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>% compact() %>% bind_rows()

  summary_table <- res_list %>%
    group_by(Mapa, RQ, Configuracion) %>%
    summarise(
      `Evacuados (Media)`  = sprintf("%.1f", mean(Evacuados, na.rm = TRUE)),
      `Fallecidos (Media)` = sprintf("%.1f", mean(Fallecidos, na.rm = TRUE)),
      `Atrapados (Media)`  = sprintf("%.1f", mean(Atrapados, na.rm = TRUE)),
      `Tiempo Medio (s)`   = sprintf("%.2f s", mean(Tiempo_Medio, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Mapa, RQ, Configuracion)

  kbl(
    summary_table,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    centering = TRUE,
    caption = "Métricas operativas de evacuación comparando C1, C2 y C3 por entorno."
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"), font_size = 9) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, latex_hline = "major")
}
